subject: Acme renewal + expansion - recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme renewal + expansion - recap & next steps

Hi Jordan / Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation. Quick recap of the items we discussed and agreed next steps so we're all aligned: 

Call summary / pain points:
- Current usage: ~2.1B tokens/month with spikes tied to end-of-quarter reports.
- Pain: unpredictable latency for peak workloads (esp. batch scoring), and token costs climbing due to duplicate requests and lack of caching.
- Security: you need SOC 2 evidence and VPC option for the expansion workloads.

Goals & expansion opportunity:
- Short term (next 3 months): stabilize latency for scoring pipeline, reduce cost ~20% via caching and quantization.
- Mid term (6-12 months): move high-volume scoring to a Dedicated pool, add embeddings for semantic search across support docs.
- Renewal: current contract renews 2027-02-15; you're open to a 12-18 month committed Dedicated plan if unit economics make sense.

Proposed upsell path and timeline:
1) Q4 (Pilot, 4-6 weeks): enable prefix/KV caching + intelligent batching on a subset of scoring jobs. Expected 15-25% token reduction.
2) Q1 (Dedicated rollout): reserve a small Dedicated pool for scoring + staging; 12-month commit considered.
3) Q2: add embeddings and monitoring; potential price uplift tied to committed capacity.

Action items / next steps: 
- Jordan: confirm which scoring job(s) you want to pilot (file name or repo path).
- Marissa: share Q3 usage report and draft proposal for pilot + Dedicated options (attached).
- Internal: loop in Ben (pricing) and Monica (onboarding/CS) for scope & timeline.

Attachments: usage_report_Q3.xlsx (exports: tokens by route, latency P95, top 10 callers)

If that aligns, I'll send a formal pilot proposal and proposed pricing by end of next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme renewal + expansion - recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa - this is helpful and captures the call well. A few clarifications from our side: \

- For the pilot, the scoring job we'd like to start with is "scoring-service/job-analytics-v2" (that's the one that runs hourly and spikes).
- SOC 2: our security team will need the SOC 2 Type II report and a list of encryption/KMS options (we prefer HSM-backed keys).
- Pricing: can you provide 3 pricing profiles (pilot, small Dedicated, committed Dedicated) with expected cost per 1M tokens after discounts?

We're generally aligned on the timeline - the key internal blocker is procurement sign-off for a committed plan, which tends to take 4-6 weeks once we have clear unit economics.

If you can send the proposal and pricing by next Thursday (10/1), I'll coordinate procurement and security to review.

Appreciate it,
Jordan
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp
jordan.smith@acme.com | (212) 555-0422

Subject: Re: Acme renewal + expansion - recap & next steps

Jordan - thanks for the fast reply. I've attached a draft proposal (ACME_proposal_v2.pdf) that includes:
- Pilot scope (4-6 weeks): caching + batching on scoring-service/job-analytics-v2; success metrics (P95 latency drop >=20%, token reduction >=15%).
- Pricing profiles:
   • Pilot: usage-based with 10% pilot credit (estimated net cost per 1M tokens)
   • Small Dedicated (monthly reserve): example pricing for a 3-GPU pool with burst allowance
   • Committed Dedicated (12-month): tiered discounts at commit levels (25% at $Xk/month, 35% at $Yk/month)
- Compliance: list of SOC 2 artifacts (we'll share Type II report) and KMS integrations (Cloud KMS + HSM option).

Ben / Monica - can you review the proposed pricing tiers and confirm if the small Dedicated example below is competitive (I used the same math as the Nimbus deal last quarter):
- Small Dedicated example: 3x A100-equivalent, expected throughput ~600 reqs/min, estimated net token cost reduction vs hosted ~28%.

Jordan - once Ben confirms, I'll send a version with line-item pricing and a proposed pilot SOW.

Thanks - Marissa

Attachments: ACME_proposal_v2.pdf

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acme pilot + renewal - internal next steps (pricing & onboarding)

Ben / Monica - looping you in with the thread above. High-level ask: please confirm pricing for the three profiles below and point to any constraints we should flag to procurement/security.

Summary (from customer):
- Account: Acme Corp (renewal 2027-02-15)
- Pilot target: scoring-service/job-analytics-v2 (hourly job, high spikes)
- Success metrics: P95 latency drop >=20%; token reduction >=15%
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II required; customer prefers HSM-backed KMS.

Pricing asks:
1) Pilot: usage-based with a 10% credit; provide example cost per 1M tokens post-credit.
2) Small Dedicated (3 GPU equiv): monthly reserve example with burst; include expected net token cost and uplift vs hosted.
3) Committed Dedicated (12-month): tiered discounts (provide price bands).

Onboarding / Ops:
- Monica: can you draft an onboarding SOW for a 4-6 week pilot (scope, success criteria, kickoff tasks)?
- Ben: if the small Dedicated math checks out, I'll attach a pricing appendix to the customer proposal.

Timeline: customer requests formal pricing by 10/01 so procurement/security can review; procurement typically needs 4-6 weeks after pricing.

I'll track responses in HubSpot and share the finalized proposal back into the thread.

Thanks,
